## ServiceSettings v0.1.3

A hardening release. Nothing new to look at — the window and the switch behave exactly as before — but the path from a card to `sc.exe` / `net.exe` was rebuilt so that neither a typo nor a hostile string can decide what runs, and three ways the stored list could drift from the real services are gone.

## Security

### A service name is now a name, not a command line

The renderer used to build the command itself — `'net start ' + serviceName` — and the main process passed that string to `cmd.exe /c`. A card named `x & calc` therefore ran `calc.exe` with the app's administrator rights. The IPC channel is now `service-command` and accepts only `{ action, name }`:

- `action` must be one of `status` / `start` / `stop`; anything else is rejected.
- `name` must match `^[\w.$-]+$`. Real service names are letters, digits, `_ . $ -`; anything that could be read as shell syntax is refused before a process is spawned.
- The command is spawned as `execFile('sc', ['query', name])` / `execFile('net', [action, name])` — argv, never a shell string, so there is nothing left to inject into.
- The whitelist and the list lookups live in `src/shared/services.js`, used by both main and renderer, so the two sides cannot drift apart again.

`sc query` is read-only and now runs without elevation; only `start` / `stop` demand it.

### Cards are built from nodes, not from HTML

The card renderer interpolated the label into `innerHTML`. It now builds elements and sets `textContent` (the service name goes into `data-service-name`), so a label cannot introduce markup or script into a page that has an IPC bridge.

## Fixes

- **Deleting a card could delete a different service.** The delete handler recovered the name from the card's title with `/.*?(?=服务)/`. A label containing 服务 was truncated, `findIndex` returned `-1`, and `list.splice(-1, 1)` removed the *last* entry of the stored list while a different card disappeared from the screen. Deletion now reads `dataset.serviceName`, and a failing lookup removes nothing.
- **The switch ignored what the command did.** `net start` / `net stop` results were discarded and the toggle flipped unconditionally, so a wrong service name, an already-stopped service or a refused command all left the card showing a state the service was not in. The toggle is now set from the command's own result and re-queried on failure, and a failed query is reported instead of being shown as "stopped".
- **A newly added card started out lying.** New entries were stored with `status: false` while the switch displayed the queried state, so the first click on a running service ran `net start` instead of `net stop`. The stored status is now the queried one, the query is done before the card is added, and `confirmBtn` is disabled meanwhile so a double click cannot insert the card twice.
- **Duplicate entries are refused.** The same label or the same service name can no longer be added twice — with one `id` per label, a duplicate used to make `getElementById` return the wrong card.
- **One elevation check, at startup.** `isAdmin()` ran inside every IPC call, and each call that found no elevation launched its own UAC prompt: refreshing three services on launch could open three elevation dialogs. The check now happens once in `whenReady` (with a re-check before start/stop), and the relaunch quotes the executable path so it also works when the app sits in `Program Files`.
- **`Tab` moves focus again.** The toggle's `keydown` handler called `preventDefault()` on every key. It now only takes <kbd>Space</kbd> and <kbd>Enter</kbd>; everything else keeps its default behaviour.

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `ServiceSettings-0.1.3-setup.exe` | NSIS installer, x64, per-user — the app relaunches itself elevated on start, so no manual "run as administrator" |

## Notes

- Windows only in practice: the app drives `sc.exe`, `net.exe` and `fltmc`. Requires Windows 10/11 (x64).
- The list stored in IndexedDB keeps its old shape (`{domName, serviceName, status, isChanging}` at `TestDB` / `config` / id `1`), so an existing list is picked up as is. A card whose stored service name is not a legal service name is kept — it is only refused when it is used.
- Stack: Electron 38 · electron-vite 4 · Vite 7 · plain ES modules and DOM (no UI framework) · IndexedDB · prettier + eslint.
